finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: filename contains shell metacharacters or commands
finding.assumptions: The filename is directly used in a system call or command execution without proper sanitization.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The ifstream constructor does not invoke a shell or any command execution; it simply opens a file for reading. Therefore, shell metacharacters in the filename cannot be interpreted as commands, and no command injection can occur.
